description: The debut?? the self-titled Taylor Swift?? girl this is a literal child with a cowboy hat and a dream and I respect the hustle but it is SO country I can't even 😭😭 'Tim McGraw' and 'Teardrops on My Guitar' are cute for nostalgia but the rest sounds like a barn. I love mother but this era was before she found the sauce, sorry not sorry 💅✨ It walked so folklore could run, and that's all the credit I'll give it.
